description: Infraestructuras del ciclo del agua en Aragón. Saneamiento is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de Aragón. Conjunto de datos provenientes del Visor de Infraestructuras del Ciclo del Agua (VICA) en su parte de Abastecimiento. El ejemplo de consulta de pozos a la vista paginada, está filtrada por 1000 registros, por la provincia de Zaragoza y por el año 2012. Enlace de ejemplo en el recurso. Coverage: Gobierno de Aragón. The publisher named on the listing is Gobierno de Aragón. Its keywords include Agua, Aragón, Depuración, Infraestructuras, Saneamiento, Ciclo del agua. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHEET, JSON, XML. The listing shows 2026-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
